caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 53 of 2009
lawyer:
Motahar Hossain, D,A.G, instructed by B. Hossain, Advocate-on-Record. ----- For the Petitioner. 
For the Respondent ------ Not Represented.
parties:
The State ------ Petitioner
VS
Dipu Mondal -------- Respondents
full_judgment: "Thus the plea of defence about the non-responsibility or non-liability of accused. Dipu Mondal for the death of his wife Lipi Begum cannot be relied upon because the decision of the aforesaid cases discarded the plea of defence. Since the victim was in the custody of the accused Dipu Mondal he must be held responsible for the death of his wife. No explanation has been offered by the accused Dipu Mondal about the death of his wife which is not reasonable and his conduct is offensive in law and as such strong presumption of his guilt can be reduced holding him responsible for the death of his wife Lipi Begum. There was throwing out of dead body of the victim Lipi Begum in the ditch in the neighborhood of the house of the accused Dipu Mondal and as such it would have to be strongly inferred that after causing the death of the victim by infliction of injuries on her person the accused Dipu Mondal himself threw out the dead body of the victim in the nearby ditch so as to give the disclosure that the victim died by sinking into the water of the ditch at the time of her taking bath faking bath is neither, believable nor practicable and the existence of injuries on the person of the victim had totally negated the fact of going of the victim to the tank for taking bath. It comes out in the evidence that the victim Lipi Begum was dumb and dull of hearing. It is also enlightened that she gave birth to a child which was born at the wedlock with the accused. Dipu Mondal. The victim was married her two years back. Ext. 4 inquest report gives out a version as written by the Investigation Officer on interrogation. During the inquest it came to be disclosed that the victim was subjected to torture by the accused Dipu Mondal and the altercation with the victim took place every now and then. It is also disclosed that the victim was dull of hearing and was also unable to speak and as such the accused subjected her to physical torture at different times for driving her from the house. It is a natural fact that the dullness of hearing and the speechlessness of the wife owing to dumbness is disliked by the husband Dipu Mondal and that disliking was the cause of altercation and unfriendliness with the deceased victim."
